_comment: Hand-maintained model card fields for the open-model report. Baked into data/open-models/models.json by scripts/open_models_bake.py; the UI hides any field left null. The bake seeds an entry automatically when a new run appears in data/open-model-analysis/.
_fieldSource: params / license / released read from the official Hugging Face model cards (checked 2026-09-16); 'activated parameters' only where the card itself states it.

internvl3_5-8b.label: InternVL3.5-8B
internvl3_5-8b.notes: Dense vision-language model (InternVLChatModel, bf16, 8,528,318,464 parameters). Apache-2.0 per the official Hugging Face card.

deepseek-vl2-small.label: DeepSeek-VL2-Small
deepseek-vl2-small.notes: Mixture-of-experts VLM built on DeepSeekMoE-16B (16,148,349,504 parameters); the model card states 2.8B activated parameters. Weights carry a custom DeepSeek licence, not an OSI one.
